description: Registered suppressions. Every live suppression directive (oxlint, eslint, ts-expect-error, ts-ignore, ts-nocheck) must match an entry by file and directive, and every entry needs a live suppression. An entry names its scope, reason, native alternatives examined, owner, versions and retirement trigger.

nativeAlternativesExamined: effect/Crypto (Crypto.Crypto.digest): asynchronous and a service, so buildPlan would gain a requirement and an error that spec 0001 does not give it; platform implementations live in runtime packages, not in the pure core.

Web Crypto crypto.subtle.digest through Effect.promise: needs an async arrow (promise-function-async autofix) that effecttsgo/async-function and eslint/require-await then reject, and reads ambient crypto authority (effect/no-ambient-authority).
node:crypto: a Node built-in, forbidden in packages/core (F11).
effect/Hash: a 32-bit non-cryptographic hash, not SHA-256.
exceptions.reason: sourceSha256 is the SHA-256 of the .fountain bytes and must be computed by a total, synchronous, pure function so buildPlan keeps an empty requirement channel. SHA-256 is defined by 32-bit rotations, shifts and xor, so eslint/no-bitwise fires on every line of the compression function.
exceptions.retirementTrigger: spec 0001 (or a successor) gives the Plan stage a Crypto requirement, or Effect ships a synchronous pure digest; then src/sha256.ts is deleted and the digest comes from the Crypto service.
